claude-acp.why: Blank, not unset: with a key in its environment Claude bills the API instead of the subscription the user signed in with. Setting the API key field replaces it.
Claude's own auto memory, off while Atlas's memory is the only one (code.claude.com/docs/en/memory).

codex-acp.why: Codex's own memories, off while Atlas's memory is the only one. The adapter ignores launch arguments, so `-c memories.…` can't reach it; CODEX_CONFIG is merged into each session's config as `-c` overrides are.

gemini.why: Identifies the host to Gemini's telemetry.
